description: One data row of central/comparison_groups.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

compare_cell.description: Comparison cell id: the compare_by attributes and their values.

p50_cost_ref.description: Median cost_ref per person in the cell (nearest rank).

p75_cost_ref.description: 75th percentile of cost_ref per person in the cell.

p90_cost_ref.description: 90th percentile of cost_ref per person in the cell.

persons.description: Number of persons in the comparison cell.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

title: gold-dataset-comparison_groups
x-cost-column-rule: No cost to sum: the cut points are quantiles, not totals.
x-grain: One row per month and comparison cell.
